status: Closed — source, forwarding regression, frozen runner, and ATM-GOV-0359 closeout re-verified on 2026-09-05
finding: The public taskflow close operator lane automatically selects --allow-stale-runner after it accepts a runner publication receipt, but it neither declares nor forwards --emergency-approval to the protected tasks close backend. The backend correctly returns ATM_EMERGENCY_LANE_APPROVAL_REQUIRED, yet the operator cannot execute the prescribed recovery through the same public seam. This creates a bootstrap circularity: a delivered framework task cannot close until the runner is current, while publishing the current runner is itself serialized behind in-flight framework work.
expectedBehavior: Any public orchestration command that selects a protected backend operation must expose and losslessly forward the corresponding bounded approval capability. The lease must only be forwarded when that protected operation is selected, must remain task/actor/flag bounded, and must still fail closed when absent, stale, mismatched, exhausted, or used for a different operation.
evidenceOrRepro: At target HEAD 16582a5ef328d6332e30f3726352412f0c898297, taskflow close for ATM-GOV-0359 accepted historical delivery refs 1bc2a250f, 5a8dccf4f and 16582a5ef and reported writeReadinessHint.status=ready. The write then generated a tasks close backend call with --allow-stale-runner and failed ATM_EMERGENCY_LANE_APPROVAL_REQUIRED. Frozen and source-first taskflow help did not advertise --emergency-approval, while tasks close already accepts it. Focused regression: tests/cli/taskflow-emergency-approval-forwarding.test.ts. Publication verified on 2026-08-14 against the runner's own declared input: release/atm-onefile/release-manifest.json at publication commit 8a3047111c7eb3673950ae719daed2801c151860 records sealedSourceCommit b3996c755027679acd995c4163fe96365f20468b with buildDecision fullRebuild and payloadReuse false, so the packed runner was rebuilt from that commit rather than reusing an earlier payload. The fix commit this item cites, 7c5c427d05c1e2493bb9d9fab9ee2d577a07cdd3, is an ancestor of that sealed source commit (git merge-base --is-ancestor 7c5c427d05c1e2493bb9d9fab9ee2d577a07cdd3 b3996c755027679acd995c4163fe96365f20468b), so the frozen runner carries it. Corroborated inside the published tree: packages/cli/dist/commands/taskflow/implementation.js at 8a3047111c7eb3673950ae719daed2801c151860 carries the emergencyApproval forwarding symbol.
followUp: The source quickfix adds a small forwarding deep module, advertises --emergency-approval on taskflow, forwards it only when runner recovery is selected, and preserves backend fail-closed behavior. The sealed runner carries the repair; taskflow-emergency-approval-forwarding.test.ts and runner-sync-framework-temp-hotfix.test.ts both exited 0 on 2026-09-05; and ATM-GOV-0359 is done, released, and residue-free. No open repair or lifecycle follow-up remains for this item.
